g1_mech#2.new: Tribo-electrostatic dry separation is established, with humidity named as the main variable. Treating -40 °C air as the enabling condition, on-site winter use in the Arctic, and bin-feedback control of plate voltage and splitters is the new angle. No source tested subzero or frozen feed. Existing work finds that heating the feed above about 80 °C helps, and that very low humidity is not automatically better. Gold and diamond ore are not typical triboelectric targets.
